ROLE: fix worker for the Mott goal-loop Bland pathway, round 24 - negative claims require a search. Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills; do not mint or deploy.

CONTEXT - measured live defect (envelope capture on v120): n_goal_response offered 'Friday 08/07/2026 11:00 am or 11:15 am'. The patient replied 'later one, unless u have after 4 instead'. The conversation STAYED on n_goal_response - no webhook ran (slot variables unchanged, no new BlandStatusCode) - yet the reply asserted 'I don't have any openings after 4 pm on Friday 08/07/2026' and repeated the same two morning slots. The model can only see slot_1/slot_2 in its variables; it cannot know what exists after 4 pm, so the negative was fabricated. This is the exact defect class the owner escalated ('you said nothing available but there is'). The graph already has n_goal_search_offered_time - the pinned-day search (from/to pinned to {{slot_1_start}}) that applies an after/anchor time filter from extraction.

THE FIX - copy every artifact from /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workR23/gl-round23-fix/ into your CWD, then edit your copies (pathway-goalloop-draft.json via build_goalloop.py or direct edit, check_goalloop_graph.py, and any build script you copied):
1. ROUTING: the n_goal_response responsePathway edge that targets n_goal_search_offered_time must explicitly cover mixed pick-plus-refinement messages. Its label/description must state that ANY time qualifier about the offered day ('after 4', 'before noon', 'later than 3', 'around 5', 'any evening ones') routes here EVEN IF the message also references an offered option ('the later one', 'option 2', 'that one'). Tighten the competing edge labels (gates, pick) so a message containing a clock-time or after/before/around/later-than qualifier does not match them. Do NOT exceed 8 outbound edges on n_goal_response and do NOT add a second edge to n_goal_search (assertion 22 constraints stay).
2. PROMPT GUARD: add the marker line 'NEGATIVE-REQUIRES-SEARCH:' to the n_goal_response prompt with this rule: never state or imply that a time, day, or window has no availability unless the immediately preceding webhook result for that exact constraint shows it; when a patient asks about a different time and no such result exists, the ONLY valid move is routing to a search - answer nothing about availability inline.
3. VALIDATOR: add assertion 24 to check_goalloop_graph.py enforcing (a) the n_goal_response -> n_goal_search_offered_time edge exists and its label or description mentions covering time qualifiers even when an offered option is referenced (check for the words 'even if' plus 'after'), and (b) the n_goal_response prompt contains 'NEGATIVE-REQUIRES-SEARCH:'. The validator must FAIL the unmodified round-23 draft citing assertion 24 and PASS your new draft. All existing assertions 1-23 stay intact.
4. FROZEN EXTRACTORS: frozen-extractors.json and every frozen extractor in the graph must remain byte-identical to the copies you inherited.

DELIVERABLES in CWD: pathway-goalloop-draft.json, check_goalloop_graph.py, build_goalloop.py (if used), frozen-extractors.json (unchanged), DEBUG.md describing the edge/label diffs and the exact new prompt text.

HARD RULES: no node deletions; do not touch n_goal_ask edge count (max 6); do not alter webhook bodies; no compound AND/OR condition values; keep every existing guard marker (NO-BOOKING-CLAIM, TIME-GRID, OFFER-INTEGRITY, NO-NEGATIVE-CLAIM, BOOKING-INTEGRITY, TIME-SILENT).

tasks.verified: The gateway resolves article-less fortnight phrasings, spelled day-of-month ordinals, and 'tail end of the month' windows, proven at the handler seam with the cumulative suite grown past 106 tests.
tasks.spec:
ROLE: fix worker for the Mott booking gateway, lane 53 (vocabulary round 3). Work entirely inside your CWD; never modify anything outside it; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no deploys, do not load skills.

CONTEXT - adversarial fuzz against the live stack surfaced three vocabulary gaps: (a) 'not this wk, fortnight from now' left the date unresolved because the lane-51 fortnight patterns require an article ('a fortnight from now' works, bare 'fortnight from now' does not); (b) spelled day-of-month ordinals fall through - a patient corrected to 'I meant the twenty-seventh' and was asked to 'provide the specific date for the twenty-seventh' even though numeric '27th' resolves; (c) 'tail end of next month' is not recognized although 'end of next month' is.

SOURCE - copy /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW52/gw-anaphora-week-fix/fixed-bland_gateway.py (byte-identical to the deployed lane-52 gateway) into your CWD as fixed-bland_gateway.py and edit that copy. Copy the cumulative test tree /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGW52/gw-anaphora-week-fix/gwtest into ./gwtest and extend it; every existing test must still pass.

THE FIX, at the same resolution seam the existing vocabulary uses:
1. FORTNIGHT: make the article optional everywhere fortnight is recognized - 'fortnight from now', 'a fortnight from now', 'in a fortnight', 'in fortnight' all resolve to today+14. Do not match 'fortnightly'.
2. SPELLED ORDINALS: 'the twenty-seventh', 'twenty seventh', 'the third', 'the thirty-first' (first through thirty-first, hyphenated or spaced) resolve as day-of-month through the SAME rule the numeric ordinal path already uses (nearest future occurrence: this month if still ahead, else next month). Reuse the existing numeric-ordinal resolution; do not build a parallel rule.
3. TAIL END: 'tail end of next month' and 'tail end of the month' resolve to the same window as 'end of next month' / 'end of the month' respectively.

DELIVERABLES in CWD:
- fixed-bland_gateway.py (full edited file)
- proof_vocab3.py - executable proof at the handler-level seam, all dates derived from datetime.date.today() so it stays valid on any run date. Print exactly:
  CASE=fortnight-no-article DATE=<(today+14).isoformat()>
  CASE=fortnight-article DATE=<(today+14).isoformat()>   (regression: 'a fortnight from now')
  CASE=spelled-twentyseventh DATE=<nearest future 27th, iso>   (this month if today.day < 27 else next month)
  CASE=spelled-third DATE=<nearest future 3rd, iso>
  CASE=tail-end-next-month WINDOW=true
  CASE=fortnightly-not-matched UNRESOLVED=true   ('see me fortnightly' must NOT resolve to a date)
- ./gwtest extended with at least 6 new tests covering all three fixes plus the fortnightly negative case.
- DEBUG-GW53.md - what changed, where, known limitations.

HARD RULES: do not weaken, remove or skip any existing test; keep resolve_anaphoric_week and all lane-51/52 behavior intact; keep the file runnable as the single gateway module it is; no placeholder code.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 ./proof_vocab3.py > proof.out 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: proof crashed'; tail -8 proof.out; exit 1; }; f14=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;print((d.date.today()+d.timedelta(days=14)).isoformat())"); o27=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();print(t.replace(day=27).isoformat() if t.day<27 else (t.replace(day=1)+d.timedelta(days=32)).replace(day=27).isoformat())"); o3=$(python3 -c "import datetime as d;t=d.date.today();print(t.replace(day=3).isoformat() if t.day<3 else (t.replace(day=1)+d.timedelta(days=32)).replace(day=3).isoformat())"); for c in "CASE=fortnight-no-article DATE=$f14" "CASE=fortnight-article DATE=$f14" "CASE=spelled-twentyseventh DATE=$o27" "CASE=spelled-third DATE=$o3" 'CASE=tail-end-next-month WINDOW=true' 'CASE=fortnightly-not-matched UNRESOLVED=true'; do grep -q "$c" proof.out || { echo "FAIL: missing $c"; cat proof.out; exit 1; }; done; grep -q 'resolve_anaphoric_week' fixed-bland_gateway.py || { echo 'FAIL: lane-52 override lost from source'; exit 1; }; cd gwtest && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q > ../pytest.out 2>&1; rc=$?; cd ..; summary=$(tail -1 pytest.out); [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo "FAIL: suite red: $summary"; tail -10 pytest.out; exit 1; }; n=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE '^[0-9]+'); [ "$n" -ge 106 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $n tests, floor is 106 (100 cumulative + 6 new)"; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: vocabulary round 3 proven - $summary"
